How the fixed quote works

When you call, we ask a few questions and give an indicative range. The engineer confirms the fixed price on arrival before touching anything. If the job turns out to be different from what was described, the engineer stops and re-quotes; you can decline at that point and pay only the call-out.

Payment

Card, bank transfer or cash, on completion. Boiler replacements can be spread over twelve months at 0% through our finance partner, subject to status.
